desc: Implement the complete Python solution using the LCS DP row bitmask automaton: parse N, M, S; precompute transitions for all 2^N masks and 26 lowercase letters by reconstructing the DP row from the mask and applying the append-character recurrence; run the length-M DP from state 0; aggregate final counts by popcount(mask) into ans[0..N] modulo 998244353; print them space-separated.
Validate the implementation on the three provided samples and edge cases (N=1, repeated characters, total sum equals 26^M mod 998244353).
